result.instructions: Tools for Teachworks, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Teachworks data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run teachworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teachworks_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teachworks_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. teachworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teachworks_list_students
tools.title: List students
tools.description: List or search students (child students of families and independent students) with their school, grade, subjects, status, billing method and default teachers. GET /students.

customer_id.description: Only students of this customer/family id.

type.description: family = child students, independent = independent students.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_student
tools.title: Get student
tools.description: Retrieve one student profile: contact details, school/grade, billing, custom fields, default teachers/services. GET /students/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List or search customers — the billed profiles: families (with child students) and independent students. Returns contact details, status and last invoice date. GET /customers.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Retrieve one customer (family or independent student) with contact details and custom fields. GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List or search employees — teachers/tutors and administrative staff — with subjects, status and wage settings. GET /employees.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_employee
tools.title: Get employee
tools.description: Retrieve one employee (teacher or staff): contact details, subjects, wage type, bio, permissions. GET /employees/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_get_employee_earnings
tools.title: Get employee earnings
tools.description: Total earnings of one employee (lessons, other events, other compensation, total) for an optional lesson status and date range. GET /employees/{id}/earnings.

date_from.description: Lessons starting on or after this date.

date_to.description: Lessons starting on or before this date.

tools.name: teachworks_get_lesson_totals
tools.title: Get lesson totals
tools.description: Lesson totals for one student, customer or employee: count (default), duration in minutes, or (employees only) earnings, broken down by status, for an optional status and date range. GET /{students|customers|employees}/{id}/lesson_totals.

id.description: The student, customer or employee id.

date_from.description: Lessons starting on or after this date.

date_to.description: Lessons starting on or before this date.

tools.name: teachworks_list_lessons
tools.title: List lessons
tools.description: List lessons (the calendar) with teacher, service, location, start/end, duration, status and participants. Filter by teacher, student, location, service, status and date range. GET /lessons.

employee_id.description: Only lessons taught by this teacher (employee id).

location_or_parent_location_id.description: Lessons at this location or any of its sub-locations.

series_id.description: Only lessons of this repeating series.

custom_status.description: Search by custom status (Custom Statuses add-on).

from_date.description: Lessons starting on exactly this date.

date_from.description: Lessons starting on or after this date.

date_to.description: Lessons starting on or before this date.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_lesson
tools.title: Get lesson
tools.description: Retrieve one lesson with its participants (students, statuses, charges, notes), teacher, wage and cost. GET /lessons/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_list_other_events
tools.title: List other events
tools.description: List non-lesson calendar events (meetings, open houses, staff work) with location, times and participants. GET /other_events.

series_id.description: Only events of this repeating series.

from_date.description: Events starting on exactly this date.

date_from.description: Events starting on or after this date.

date_to.description: Events starting on or before this date.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_list_availabilities
tools.title: List teacher availability
tools.description: List teachers' weekly availability slots (day of week + start/end time). Use before scheduling a lesson. GET /availabilities.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with customer, number, dates, status (Saved, Approved, Paid, Void) and totals. Filter by customer, status, invoice date or due date range. GET /invoices.

due_to.description: Due date on or before (e.g. today, to find overdue invoices together with status Approved).

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Retrieve one invoice with its line items (lessons, charges), taxes and totals. GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List customer payments (amount, method, date, refunds, invoice allocations). Filter by customer and date range. GET /payments.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_get_payment
tools.title: Get payment
tools.description: Retrieve one payment with its refunds and the invoices it is allocated to. GET /payments/{id}.

tools.name: teachworks_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List locations and sub-locations (rooms) where lessons take place. GET /locations.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List services (lesson types such as 'Math Tutoring') with their default cost and wage. GET /services.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_list_subjects
tools.title: List subjects
tools.description: List standard subjects (used on student and teacher profiles). GET /subjects.

direction.description: Sort by id ascending (default) or descending (newest first).

tools.name: teachworks_create_family
tools.title: Create family
tools.description: WRITE: create a family customer (the billed parent profile that child students belong to). Add children afterwards with teachworks_create_child_student. POST /customers/family.

status.description: Defaults to Active; use Prospective for leads.

tools.name: teachworks_create_child_student
tools.title: Create child student
tools.description: WRITE: create a child student under an existing family (the family is billed for their lessons). POST /students.

customer_id.description: The family (customer) id the student belongs to.

tools.name: teachworks_create_lesson
tools.title: Create lesson
tools.description: WRITE: schedule a single lesson on the calendar for one or more students with a teacher, service and location. Check teachworks_list_availabilities and teachworks_list_lessons first to avoid conflicts. POST /lessons.

service_id.description: Service id (sets the default cost and wage).

time_zone.description: Rails time zone name, e.g. 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)' (defaults to the account's).

tools.name: teachworks_add_student_to_lesson
tools.title: Add student to lesson
tools.description: WRITE: add a student to an existing lesson (the lesson must still be Scheduled). PUT /lessons/{id}/add_student.

tools.name: teachworks_create_payment
tools.title: Record payment
tools.description: WRITE: record a payment received from a customer (bookkeeping only — it does not charge a card). POST /payments.
